inspiration: Terrain-tinted contact shadow: a soft quad under each character takes the colour of its ground type. Keep the cheap contact cue; make ours a radial gradient tinted from a zone terrain tag.
Ease-to-behind camera: heading eases a fraction per frame using frame time, capped at one step, with shortest-arc wrap. Keep the ease and the wrap; our fight camera stays locked during engage.
Placeable bar stack: a cast/timer bar can be moved and resized in a preview state, then locked. Keep the preview-and-lock flow; anchor above the hero and label bars with ability names.

Two-button run with autorun toggle: holding both buttons runs with mouse steering, and any movement key cancels autorun. Keep the cancel rule; touch gets a hold-to-run and a tap toggle with a visible chip.
Night floor: a floor under the ambient light keeps the day/night shape and lifts dark scenes. Keep the floor idea as a grade floor, not an ambient override.
Name-keyed tunable registry: each tunable is a named variable with a category, and a dump tool lists them. Keep one dumpable registry keyed by name; ours is zone and catalogue data read at boot.
Name to id by table lookup: the asset catalogue is a direct table read, not a filename hash. Keep an explicit name-to-id table as the single source of truth.
